primary_objective: Land the spacecraft on the landing pad at (0,0) with zero velocity, upright orientation, and minimal fuel consumption, as fast as possible.
objective_decomposition: Phase 1: Descent and stabilization - reduce vertical speed, center horizontally over pad, maintain upright orientation.
Phase 2: Final approach - fine-tune position and velocity to land softly on pad with both legs contacting simultaneously.
Phase 3: Landing - zero velocity, upright, both legs on ground, terminate with success.
behavior_trajectory_alignment: Phase 1: Descent and stabilization - reduce vertical speed, center horizontally over pad, maintain upright orientation.
Phase 2: Final approach - fine-tune position and velocity to land softly on pad with both legs contacting simultaneously.
Phase 3: Landing - zero velocity, upright, both legs on ground, terminate with success.
metric_priority: Episodic return (cumulative reward) averaged over many episodes.
primary_selection_metric: Episodic return (cumulative reward) averaged over many episodes.
proxy_metrics: Distance to pad at end of episode.
Vertical speed at first ground contact.
Fuel consumption (total main engine power used).
diagnostic_metrics: Success rate (landing on pad with both legs, low speed, upright).
Average horizontal and vertical speed at touchdown.
Average fuel used per successful landing.
success_criteria: Both legs ground contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Episode termination without crash or out-of-bounds.
failure_modes: Hovering indefinitely at safe altitude without landing (avoids crash but never succeeds).
Landing with high vertical speed (crash) but receiving small negative reward if not penalized enough.
Using orientation engines excessively causing oscillation or wasted fuel.
Landing outside pad but with low speed (no crash, but not success).
bad_local_optima: Hovering indefinitely at safe altitude without landing (avoids crash but never succeeds).
Landing with high vertical speed (crash) but receiving small negative reward if not penalized enough.
Using orientation engines excessively causing oscillation or wasted fuel.
Landing outside pad but with low speed (no crash, but not success).
reward_generator_constraints: Reward must be a scalar float returned by compute_reward.
Must encourage landing on pad with low speed and upright orientation.
Should penalize crashes and out-of-bounds strongly.
Should provide shaping (e.g., distance-based, velocity-based) to guide learning.
Fuel penalty should be mild to avoid discouraging necessary engine use.
Avoid reward components that conflict (e.g., penalizing angle while requiring orientation engine use).
Ensure reward is bounded and stable for training.
